title: The FastLanes Compression Layout: Decoding >100 Billion Integers per Second with Scalar Code
relevance: Demonstrates how interleaved columnar layouts enable massive decode throughput via data-parallelism, directly applicable to columnar materialization of CSV data.

title: Benchmarking Apache Arrow Flight
relevance: Benchmarks Arrow's columnar format for data transfer, showing zero-copy columnar exchange at 6000 MB/s -- the target output format for our CSV parser.

title: Lance: Efficient Random Access in Columnar Storage through Adaptive Structural Encodings
relevance: Explores structural encoding strategies for columnar formats that optimize both sequential and random access, informing how we should layout CSV-derived columnar data.

title: Boosting Data Filtering on Columnar Encoding with SIMD
relevance: SIMD-based filtering on columnar encoded data achieving 18 billion numbers/second throughput, demonstrating the performance potential of columnar+SIMD integration.
